dispositions.evidence: Round-3 minor: the trailing-slash rstrip guard is untested; a trailing-slash origin would otherwise render repo.git/.git. Deferred to issue #33 item 5.
Round-3 minor: the canonicalization test pins only HTTPS origins; the SSH no-suffix class is untested though the function handles it. Deferred to issue #33 item 4.

findings.evidence: the change adds the trailing-slash guard `value = url.rstrip("/")` in canonical_repo_url, but the new test `test_origin_with_and_without_git_suffix_same_package` exercises only the origin forms `https://example.com/owner/repo` and `https://example.com/owner/repo.git`; deleting the rstrip guard leaves that test green, because neither origin carries a trailing slash and neither reaches the guarded path, while an origin stored as `.../repo.git/` would then fail `endswith(".git")` and render `repo.git/.git` — a different repository path — so the byte-identical rebuild the docstring claims is unpinned for that input form
findings.required_change: extend test_origin_with_and_without_git_suffix_same_package with a trailing-slash origin form, e.g. build with origin `https://example.com/owner/repo.git/` and assert the package is byte-identical to the canonical `.../repo.git` build, so that deleting the rstrip guard at the cited hunk fails the suite

findings.evidence: test_origin_with_and_without_git_suffix_same_package pins only the HTTPS origin class: it builds with 'https://example.com/owner/repo' vs '…/repo.git' and anchors with assertIn("repo: https://example.com/owner/repo.git\n"). No test in the package exercises an SSH origin without the '.git' suffix; the preceding visible test asserts only 'repo: git@github.com:owner/repo.git' for an origin that already carries '.git', which stays green with or without canonical_repo_url. Production change that passes falsely: delete canonical_repo_url and revert the call site to 'origin = strip_userinfo(origin)' — an SSH checkout whose origin is 'git@github.com:owner/repo' (no suffix) would again rebuild a non-identical package, and every test in this diff stays green because neither the byte-equality assertion nor the assertIn anchor covers that input class.
findings.required_change: Add a case in the same fixture class that builds with an SSH origin lacking the suffix ('git@github.com:owner/repo'), then set-url to the '.git' form, and asserts the two packages are byte-identical plus assertIn("repo: git@github.com:owner/repo.git\n") — so removing canonical_repo_url fails the suite for the SSH class too, anchored at the cited test hunk.
